editor.subir.guarda_antes: To add your own images or fonts, first save a copy of the theme with your name.
editor.subir.grande: The file is over 10 MB. Try a smaller one.
editor.soltar.no_imagen: Only PNG, JPG or GIF images can be dropped here. Fonts are chosen in the panel on the right.
editor.soltar.lleno: A theme can have {max} elements at most.
editor.avisos.si: OK: I'll tell you when there's a new version. You can change this in “Settings”.
editor.avisos.no: OK: I won't look for new versions. You can change this in “Settings”.
editor.actualizar.incluido: Before updating, save your changes with “Save as…”: you're editing an included theme.
editor.actualizar.errores: Before updating, fix the fields marked in red so the theme can be saved.
editor.guardar_como.errores: First fix the fields marked in red, then “Save as…” again.
editor.guardado.errores: Couldn't save: fix the fields marked in red.
editor.restaurado: Restored to how it was when opened. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
editor.aviso.incluido.texto: You can try changes here, but to keep them make your own copy with “Save as…”.
editor.aviso.letras: The font is missing some letters:
editor.aviso.letras.texto: They'll show as boxes on the screen: change the text or choose another font.
editor.aviso.vista_previa.texto: The last one that worked is shown.
editor.iman.ayuda: When moving and resizing, edges land on multiples of 4 pixels. Hold Alt to turn it off for a moment.
editor.contornos.ayuda: Draws the outline of every element so you can find them even when empty.
editor.zoom.ayuda: Canvas size on your monitor (it doesn't change the real screen)
editor.teclas.etiqueta: Keyboard shortcuts: arrows to move (Shift, 10 pixels), Del to delete, Ctrl+D to duplicate, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y to undo and redo, Alt+click to select the layer below
editor.teclas.ayuda:
Keyboard shortcuts
←↑→↓  move (Shift: 10 px)
Del  delete
Ctrl+D  duplicate
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y  undo / redo
Alt+click  select the layer below
editor.nueva.titulo: There's a new version of Luzeira
editor.nueva.texto1: You have {version} and {nueva} is ready, checked with Luzeira's signature.
editor.nueva.texto2: When updating, Luzeira closes for a few seconds (the screen turns off), installs itself and opens again. Your themes and settings stay as they are, and whatever you're editing is saved first.
editor.avisos.titulo: Shall I tell you about new versions?
editor.avisos.texto1: Luzeira can check GitHub once a day for a new version and let you know. It never installs anything until you press “Update”, and every version is signed: if the signature isn't Luzeira's, it isn't installed.
editor.avisos.texto2: Checking sends nothing about you: it only asks for the list of versions, like a browser.
editor.restaurar.texto: It goes back to how it was when you opened it. If you change your mind, Ctrl+Z undoes it.
editor.borrar.texto: “{elemento}” will be removed from the screen. You can get it back with Undo (Ctrl+Z).
editor.papelera.texto: It disappears from the list, but it isn't fully deleted: it stays in Luzeira's “papelera” (trash) folder in case you want it back.
editor.papelera.en_pantalla: It's the theme on the screen right now: “Esencial” will be put in its place.
editor.descartar.texto: You changed an included theme, and those changes can't be saved in it. If you leave now, they're lost.
editor.guardar_como.nota.incluido: A copy with its images is created in “My themes”. The included theme doesn't change.
editor.guardar_como.nota.guardado: Your changes are already saved in “{tema}”. This creates a new copy with its images.
editor.guardar_como.nota.sin_guardar: A new copy is created with its images and with what you see now. “{tema}” keeps what was last saved.
